CFML Language Reference: Functions

CreateObject

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

The function form of CFOBJECT: loads a Java class (or creates a COM component or CORBA object) and returns it, so that you can call its methods and read and set its fields.

Category

System functions

Syntax

CreateObject("JAVA", class)
CreateObject("COM", class [, context [, servername ] ])
CreateObject("CORBA", class, context [, locale ])

Parameters

type
"JAVA", "COM" or "CORBA".
class
Java: the full class name, such as "java.util.Vector" (case sensitive). COM: the ProgID of the component, such as "Word.Application". CORBA: the IOR file name or the naming service name.
context
COM: "InProc", "Local" or "Remote". CORBA: "IOR" or "NameService".
servername
COM with context "Remote": the server running the component.
locale
CORBA: arguments for the ORB.

Returns

The object. A Java class is loaded but not yet constructed: call init(args) to run a constructor, or just call a method, which runs the constructor without arguments first. Static methods and fields work right away.

Usage

Everything CFOBJECT says about Java objects applies: method and field names are not case sensitive, CFML values are converted to and from Java types, JavaCast picks between overloaded methods, and Java exceptions become errors of type Object (see GetException). Without a Java Virtual Machine, and always for COM and CORBA on KoldFusion for UNIX, the function throws an error of type Object, so wrap calls in CFTRY when the page must also run elsewhere. CreateObject is disabled together with CFOBJECT by the Basic Security tag restrictions.

Inside CFSCRIPT, Java objects read naturally:

<CFSCRIPT>
list = CreateObject("JAVA", "java.util.Vector");
list.addElement("Netscape");
list.addElement("Mosaic");
count = list.size();
</CFSCRIPT>

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Kinds = "JAVA|java.util.Vector,JAVA|java.util.Random,COM|Word.Application,CORBA|c:\myobject.ior">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>CreateObject()</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Kinds#" INDEX="k">
  <CFTRY>
    <CFSET Obj = CreateObject(ListFirst(k, "|"), ListLast(k, "|"), "IOR")>
    <CFSET Result = "Created: <TT>#Obj.toString()#</TT>">
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Object">
    <CFSET Result = "<I>#CFCATCH.Message#</I>">
  </CFCATCH>
  </CFTRY>
  <CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>"#ListFirst(k, "|")#", "#ListLast(k, "|")#"</TD><TD>#Result#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<CFTRY>
  <CFSET Words = CreateObject("JAVA", "java.util.StringTokenizer")>
  <CFSET Words.init("one small step for man", " ")>
  <CFOUTPUT><P>StringTokenizer counted #Words.countTokens()# words.</P></CFOUTPUT>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Object"><CFOUTPUT><P><I>#CFCATCH.Message#</I></P></CFOUTPUT></CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
